intro: The Lattice bed gives you deep sleep and deeper storage. With its clean panels and colour-block tone, it helps you stay organised — while turning your bed into the boldest thing in the room.

features.title: Strong foundations, elegant feel
features.text: Our engineered wood frame offers reliable support with a clean, thoughtful design — crafted to blend strength and sophistication in one perfect piece.

features.title: Box storage that keeps it all together
features.text: With easy-access compartments beneath the bed, organising your space has never been simpler — making room for the things you love, without the mess. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Headboard comfort that goes beyond sleep
features.text: Soft and supportive, the cushioned headboard is perfect for everything from bedtime reads to slow, peaceful mornings.

features.title: A finish that adds quiet character
features.text: The textured matte wood surface brings a calming, tactile quality to your space — soft to the eye, warm to the touch.

features.title: Storage that meets you at eye level
features.text: The headboard’s clever compartments and extra ledge give you practical, beautiful space to store and display what matters most.

name: Upmods Lattice Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
